name: cowork-insights
description: Cowork usage analytics for Claude Desktop — full-history session/token/model/tool report with no 30-day limit, split into confirmed Cowork vs ambiguous desktop-app sessions (the logs cannot tell Cowork's mounted mode from the Code tab). Read-only, zero-dependency (Python stdlib, or the in-box PowerShell port when Python is missing), Windows.

output_dir.title: Report output directory
output_dir.description: Where cowork-insights writes its reports. Leave empty to use the plugin data directory (or ~/.claude/usage-data/cowork-insights as fallback).
